202A.11 / CHAPTER 11 OF 11

How to trade the demand wave

How big could the wave be, when could it arrive, and which approach can capture it?

11 chapters with worked investigations

01Price moves at the margin02Liquidity & price impact03Buy/sell pressure04Supply transfer05Early wallet flow06Demand acceleration07Attention conversion08Push, Hold or Fail09Meta saturation10Three basic checks11How to trade the demand wave

01Definition

Assess the coming flow of demand first, then shape the trade around its expected size and timing. Snipe and swing are containers for capturing an early entry and selling into the rise; PvP adds competition for the same attention and capital.

02Why it matters

You enter early, before the expected rise, and sell into that rise. A good story at a late price is a different opportunity. The approach must fit the demand wave rather than forcing the token into a preferred holding period.

03What to check

  • Assess the wave: use the three basic checks to identify fresh demand, plausible scale, timing, and competing tokens. For a swing, deepen all three checks before entry.
  • Shape the container: choose snipe, PvP rotation, or swing; define an early entry condition, exposure that fits usable liquidity, and where or when to sell into the expected rise.
  • Define the frame: state the required upward pressure, the time allowed for it to produce the move, and the exit when it fails, fades, or the planned rise has been captured.

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Entry precedes the anticipated run. Demand and price follow-through develop inside the defined window, and exits realize gains into the rise. Exposure fits executable liquidity.

Dangerous

Entry chases a wave that has already passed. The required buying fails to arrive, sellers take over, or a failed snipe is relabeled as a swing to avoid exiting.

05Beginner mistake

Choosing the holding period first, treating a later recovery as proof that a failed snipe worked, or waiting indefinitely for a thesis to become demand.

06Takeaway

Assess the wave, build the container, enter early, and sell into the rise. If the necessary pressure fails within the defined frame and time, the trade has failed.

Assess demand -> choose the container -> enter early -> sell into the rise -> exit on failure.

Snipe: upward pressure must exist immediately or be building, and produce the run while you are in. Without it, within this snipe frame the trade can only go down: exit.

Frame and time define success. A later recovery outside the window cannot validate the original snipe.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    Illustrative snipe: early attention and buying are building before the run. Define a short window for upward pressure to produce the move, enter only while the early-entry condition holds, and plan to sell into the rise.

  2. 02

    Illustrative PvP rotation: two exact-contract tokens compete for the same story. Compare fresh buyers, credible backing, remaining insider inventory, and liquidity. Stay only while the chosen wave holds; reassess a rival without chasing its completed burst.

  3. 03

    Illustrative swing: a catalyst is expected inside 3-14 days. Deepen the thesis, supply and contract checks, and holder behavior; enter before anticipated demand, plan profit-taking into the rise, and exit if the catalyst or sustained-demand case fails.

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

Two traders assess the same illustrative wave. One enters before the anticipated buying and sells into the rise. The other arrives after the burst and calls the same story an early entry. The story did not change, but the captured part of the wave did. If the first trader instead gets no upward follow-through inside the preset snipe window, that snipe fails even if price rises much later.

How to investigate it

Write the demand source, expected scale and arrival window first. Choose snipe, PvP rotation or swing accordingly. Specify the early-entry condition, position size against usable liquidity, planned profit-taking, and time or thesis invalidation. For a swing, expand all three checks into catalyst and demand persistence, supply and structural risk, and holder behavior. Monitor buying that absorbs selling and produces price response. A five-minute collection is a bounded sample, not a live snipe execution signal.

Check your reasoning — answered

You planned a short snipe, but upward pressure never produces the run within your defined window. Price recovers the next day. Did the snipe succeed? No. Its necessary condition failed inside its frame and time. Exit on that failure; any later opportunity needs a new assessment rather than a retrospective change of definition.

Try it on a token

See it in Meme Fast → Snipe

Compare sampled buying, selling, absorption, and price response in Inspect; use Tweet for competing story evidence and Swing for longer-horizon leads. The scheduled sample cannot establish immediate execution timing or a complete live tape.

Go deeper

Snipe is a short timing approach: immediate or building buying pressure must absorb selling and produce price follow-through during the intended exposure. Set the holding window before entry; no follow-through or fading pressure means exit rather than convert it to a swing. PvP means competing for participation, often between tokens claiming the same narrative. Snipe timing can overlap with PvP; monitor current leadership, rival demand, and the cost of rotation. Swing uses the same entry checks more comprehensively: thesis, meta, comparables and catalysts over 3-14 days; liquidity and contract controls, bundles, dev sales and cheap early supply; holder composition, accumulation versus distribution, and new demand absorbing sellers. Product or ecosystem success matters only if it supports token demand. Migration may create a wave of anticipation, but technical completion alone does not create renewed buying; confirm the event and assess demand before and after. Position size, executable quotes, profit-taking and invalidation must fit the chosen window. The low and high are the intended early-entry and exit regions, not exact extrema known in advance.
